data.long_meaning: Derived from the Persian word 'mahvashan', meaning 'graceful' or 'beautiful'. In Persian culture, it is a name given to girls to express the parents' hope for their child's beauty and grace. The name Mahvash carries the meaning “Graceful, Beautiful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mahvash usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful, beautiful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
